summary:
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config)** — Multiple ALLEGRO reconstruction improvements landed this week: TRAPPIST inference for π⁰/photon particle identification was integrated into both `o1_v03` and `o2_v01` configurations (with tests exercising both topocluster and SW cluster paths) in [#392](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/392), vertex and silicon-wrapper resolutions were updated to 3 µm spatial / 5 ns timing and the wrapper reduced to a single layer in [#384](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/384), STT hits are now consumed by the ALLEGRO_o2_v01 track finder and the STT digitiser was enabled in the reconstruction chain in [#388](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/388) and [#396](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/396), and a crash from the `DCHdigi_v02` → `WireTrackerDigi_v01` renaming was patched in [#395](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/395). New IDEA Delphes/EDM4hep cards and refreshed Pythia8 ZH/ZZ/WW generator cards at 240 GeV were also added in [#393](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/393).
- **[key4hep/k4geo](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo)** — A large refactor of the IDEA/ALLEGRO vertex detector introduced the `FCC-SEED` vertex option (available across ALLEGRO, CLD as new `CLD_o5_v01`, ILD_FCCee, and IDEA), updated ALLEGRO pixel pitches and reduced the silicon wrapper to one layer, and moved the resolution array logic in [#612](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/612). The ALLEGRO HCAL endcap pseudo-layer position calculation used by PandoraPFA was fixed in [#666](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/666), which affects clustering geometry for downstream PFA users.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker)** — `DCHdigi_v02` was generalised and renamed to `WireTrackerDigi_v01` so a single digitiser now serves both drift chamber and straw-tube trackers (selected via the new `isSTT` Gaudi property), with a backward-compatible alias for existing configs added in [#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/103) after the initial rename in [#100](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/100). This affects any workflow instantiating `DCHdigi_v02` and required corresponding updates in Genfit tracking code.
- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter)** — Introduced a full seeded ECAL clustering chain for the IDEA o2 dual-readout calorimeter, comprising `CaloDrivenClusterSeeding`, `TrackDrivenClusterSeeding`, `ClusterSeedMerging`, and `ClusterSeedGrower`, together with a new `CreateOpticalCaloCells` bridge from optical-photon SimHits to CalorimeterHits and a CI test for the IDEA o2 reconstruction chain in [#271](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/271).
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking)** — Local EDM4hep conversion code was replaced with the upstream `ActsPlugins::EDM4hepUtil` in [#95](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/95), which also fixes the track state covariance layout so downstream consumers now read the correct elements in EDM4hep parameter order (a correctness fix visible to any client of ACTS-produced tracks). A pass-through `ClassifiedEdgePrinting` stage was added to aid GNN pipeline debugging [#105](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/105), an edge-orientation step matching the acorn training convention was added to the GNN track finder [#103](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/103), and support for the new named ACTS material-map field was added in [#104](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/104).
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes)** — Photon pointing information is now stored in EDM4hep output: pointing angles land in `ITheta`/`IPhi` with uncertainty in `directionError`, and hit-position errors in `positionError` ([#161](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/161)). This requires Delphes ≥ 3.5.2pre02.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore)** — The `OverlayTiming` background particle index mapping was simplified from per-frame `std::map` lookups to direct offset indexing in [#429](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/429), which also fixes a bug that silently dropped daughter references when the target particle had no relations of its own — a correctness improvement plus measurable speedup. `k4run` gained an `--evt-max` alias for `ApplicationMgr.EvtMax` in [#431](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/431), and the data-handle API was updated for Gaudi 41's new `EventContext` interface in [#432](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/432).
- **[key4hep/EDM4hep](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep)** — The deprecated `Track::getTrackState(int32_t)` overload is now hidden from Cling/cppyy in [#524](https://github.com/key4hep/EDM4hep/pull/524) to prevent Python bindings from resolving to the wrong overload, fixing a user-visible issue in Python-based analyses.
- **[AIDASoft/DD4hep](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep)** — The CSG-based DDCAD ASSIMP writer was removed in [#1681](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1681) after ROOT made `RCsg`/`CsgOps.h` private, unblocking builds against current ROOT; a replacement using only public ROOT interfaces is planned as a follow-up. Deprecated `RVersion.h` includes were also migrated to `ROOT/RVersion.hxx` in [#1680](https://github.com/AIDASoft/DD4hep/pull/1680).
- **[key4hep/key4hep-spack](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack)** — A fish-shell setup script for the Key4hep stack was added in [#922](https://github.com/key4hep/key4hep-spack/pull/922), giving fish users a native alternative to the bash setup.
- **[hep-fcc/root2gltf](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf)** — Overlapping child volumes are now shrunk to render distinctly from their parents, transparency was improved (40% → 100%), the default `numFaces` build option was lowered to 1000, and several conversion-logic cleanups landed in [#15](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/root2gltf/pull/15), improving detector visualisations produced for Phoenix.
